integrity: The analytical derivation proves the stated finite-n identity; finite computational diagnostics do not constitute proof for arbitrary n. No external independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only iid normalized-area-uniform samples on the unit two-sphere in Euclidean 3-space. All unordered triples are counted (not just convex-hull facets when n>4). Only first two moments and pairwise dependence are classified; full distribution and nonuniform sampling are not addressed. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact variance of acute Euclidean chord triangles on a sphere
